name: NVIDIA GeForce3 Volume Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Nvidia GeForce3 Hardware Volume Rendering with Dependent Texture Reads
definition: A rendering pipeline for the NVIDIA GeForce3 series that uses dependent texture reads on a per-fragment basis and 4-way multi-texturing to eliminate the need for a scratch buffer.
summary: The NVIDIA GeForce3 Volume Rendering Pipeline is a hardware-accelerated method using dependent texture reads to eliminate scratch buffers, though it restricts transfer functions to separable components.
